body.label: Trigger
body.html: You are targeted by a close-range Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Gain +1 Defense against the triggering Action. You may spend 1 Combo to increase this bonus by 1.

surges.html: One adjacent ally also gains +1 Defense against the triggering effect.
Gain +1 Defense against the triggering creature until the start of your next turn.
